tables.caption: List of amino acid sequences, net charge and growth inhibitory concentrations against F. graminearum PH-1.
footnotes: Type = Protein/peptide conformation; Mixed αβ means, structure includes both α-helix and β-strand conformation. Unknown = peptide structure not determined.
Net charge of the peptide was determined using Biochemistry Online- http://vitalonic.narod.ru/biochem/index_en.html.
Amount of protein (µM) required for inhibiting 50% growth of F. graminearum.
Amount of protein (µM) required to inhibit F. graminearum conidial germination completely.
Cysteines are indicated in bold font.
